profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at City Electric Supply
profile.summary: Currently developing software for purchasing, sales, invoicing and inventory.  Code base is Delphi which is heavily dependent on SQL.  Recent projects have been on EDI development and backend software for our growing web presence.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Development in Delphi and SQL.  
Developed automated processes connecting inventory movement between brick and mortar stores and  online stores.  
Other projects have focus on extending EDI processes by parsing and filing EDI documents for invoicing, purchasing, and returns. 
Also provide bug support for a large and mature codebase.

positions.title: Automation and Robotics Development
positions.description: Develop several proof of concept automation projects centered around a Universal Robot handling small pieces.  Also provided troubleshooting for other automated machines in the production process.
positions.insights: Skills: Servo Drives · Robot · NI LabVIEW

positions.title: University Lecturer
positions.description:
Teaching a very wide range of linguistics courses in Thailand, Nigeria, North Dakota University, and Dallas International University. 
-Most work was done on previously unwritten languages.   Students from these languages were my students and I helped 30+ produce publishable MA theses, conference proceedings, and journal articles.  These were non-native English speakers producing the first real documentation by native speakers of their own languages.   Each project took several months and involved developing plans for the writing process and their professional development.  
-Developed metrics used to evaluate thesis research.  These were adopted across multiple departments.
-Created applications to assist with converting and analyzing language data. 
-Planned and oversaw more than thirty research programs resulting in publications and archived digital data. 
-Served on leadership committees and developed curriculum guidelines using a knowledge-skills-abilities KSA methodology.
-Developed thesis rubrics adopted by all programs in the graduate school.  
-Created, found funding and staffed a small research foundation.   

This teaching was done in connection with my role in Wycliffe Bible Translators

positions.title: Linguistic Consultant
positions.description:
Helped field linguists with their data with the aim to publish results and archive files in a permanent repository.  Wrote programs to move data from legacy software to more recent software.   Often data was pre-unicode and one-off programs had to be written to handle conversion.   
I also had to train researchers on proper procedure and protocols that would result in valid data.

positions.title: International Coordinator for Materials and Standards
positions.description: For a time, I was International Coordinator for Materials and Standard. Responsible for managing the redefinition of all language related roles and matching appropriate competencies/learning objectives to each position.  Also collected existing digital records of SIL training schools and created an online repository.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Inventory and production control system development:
Designed, wrote and implemented inventory and production control software in Delphi.  Project management included documenting existing production processes, interviewing users to identify felt needs, developing a global project plan, writing most of the code and then guiding team members in instituting necessary production and inventory control changes.  Wrote both back-end and front-end programs. .  The underlying database structure was Btrieve (from Great Plains), Dbase and SQL.   Also created several small office automation software products. 

Fanuc robot installation and programming:  	         
Installed, wired, and TPP programmed 15 Fanuc robotic work cells used to perform a variety of woodworking operations and lacquer application.  Responsible for complete robot cell installation including all robot configuration and programming.  Cell installation included the assembly, wiring and programming (both motion control and i/o) of auxiliary machines.  Fanuc models included S-6, M-6i, LRmate, and PaintSeries P-50i.   Also trained operators to the level of creating new programs from existing programs.

Custom machine programming:
Assembled, wired and programmed multiple custom automation machines developed in house.  Examples include a CNC gluer, adding a Z-axis to wood CNC laser, and creating an automated tool-changer for a CNC router. Controllers included PCs, ladder logic PLCs, programmable inverters, and Compumotor PLCs. Some projects involved interfacing with inventory and order entry data.  This was done using Delphi and SQL.

positions.title: Independent Software Developer
positions.description:
Most work was done 1998-2003.  Some recent contract work was performed in 2018.
Fanuc Robot Programming
Redid all TPP software on a laqcuer/paint robot.  Trained users to the level of creating new programs
Labview Programming
Developed Labview software controlling automated test fixtures for Siemens and another large automotive parts manufacturer. Instruments controlled included: servo drives, encoders, lvdt devices, thermo-couples, vacuums, multi-meters, strain-gauges and i/o boards.  Test stands were capable of several different tests and could be extensively reconfigured by users. Formatted and archived results for later analysis.

positions.title: Research Analyst
positions.description: Was a research analysis and database programmer. This was a project funded by the Federal Aviation Administration to assess the qualification an aviation maintenance technician. Responsibilities involved creating and implementing a survey methodology, administered survey, and conducting interviews of management and survey participants at several aircraft maintenance facilities. The results were presented results at industry meetings.  A publication was also produced
